analyst.summary: Signatureglobal's core sales engine slowed sharply this quarter -- the number of homes sold fell about 71% from a year earlier -- even as the company pushes into an unfamiliar premium segment with its first branded-luxury project. Profitability and interest coverage are both currently negative. While the company holds healthy cash reserves, the combination of a real sales slowdown and a strategic pivot into unproven territory is a genuine concern, not just weak sentiment.
